summary: Deployment-hardening regression pass (iter-Feb-2026 v5). Backend: 17/17 automated tests PASS. Verified — backend starts cleanly on 8001, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME required guards active (no fallback used), all 4 role logins work (implant_incharge=Abhijit.patil correctly seeded), Zygoma workflow end-to-end works (create Quad-Zygoma procedure → PATCH /zygoma-workflow phase2 → dual cosign (supervisor + incharge) → GET /zygoma-cosigns returns phase2_ready=true), implant-library filtering (default=conventional only, ?implant_type=advanced returns Refirm Z-Series + P-Series, ?implant_type=all returns both), 15 procedure types incl. 5 Zygoma variants, admin /access-logs endpoint reachable, non-TTL query indexes (user_id+created_at & resource_type+resource_id+created_at) present on access_logs, push send_push_notification() no-ops when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY unset (verified env + no 5xx). Frontend: login screen loads, 4-role login works, dashboard renders 5 Zygoma cases visible, direct navigation to /procedures/zygoma-workflow/{id} renders extended workflow header + Phase 2/3/4/5 cards + surgical checklist + implants-placed section + supervisor/incharge cosign panel. NOTE — legacy TTL index (created_at expireAfterSeconds=15552000) still present on the DEV MongoDB access_logs collection from prior deploys; the hardening removed TTL from startup so a FRESH deploy DB will not create it, but existing environments retain the legacy index (non-blocking, flagged as warning).

minor.issue: Legacy TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=15552000) still present on access_logs in existing dev DB. Startup no longer creates it (fresh deploys are safe), but dev/staging DBs migrated from pre-hardening code will retain it. Consider one-time db.access_logs.dropIndex('created_at_1') during dev cleanup — not a deploy blocker.

action_items: OPTIONAL (dev only, non-blocking): drop the legacy TTL index on access_logs.created_at in the dev/staging MongoDB. Prod fresh deploys are already safe since startup no longer creates it.
No regressions found — deployment hardening changes verified transparent to end users.
